hypotheses.F0_native_branch_is_exact: The unmodified manual branch matches the native model with maximum logit error at most 1e-4.
hypotheses.F1_boundary_has_finite_local_effect: Removing matched L9H8 boundary edges has local-effect AUROC at least 0.60 in both splits.
hypotheses.F2_boundary_reaches_output: Removing matched L9H8 boundary edges has final-logit KL AUROC at least 0.55 in both splits.
hypotheses.F3_L7H8_function_read_is_finite: Removing matched L7H8 adjacent-function-word edges has local-effect AUROC at least 0.60 and KL AUROC at least 0.55 in both splits.
hypotheses.F4_L9H7_function_read_is_finite: Removing matched L9H7 adjacent-function-word edges has local-effect AUROC at least 0.60 and KL AUROC at least 0.55 in both splits.
hypotheses.F5_relations_are_head_specific: The predicted head exceeds its declared head control by at least 0.05 local-effect AUROC in both splits for both surviving relations.
hypotheses.F6_failed_name_relation_stays_negative: L8H1 adjacent-name removal fails to reach both local AUROC 0.60 and KL AUROC 0.55 in at least one split.
